summaryDeep: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking work smoothly with your depth, control, and willingness to be exposed. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The challenge is that potential alone is not enough. It can be easy to appreciate the possibility of depth without fully stepping into it. If difficult conversations are continually avoided, the relationship may remain supportive and interesting, but some of its greatest opportunities for understanding and growth may never be realized.
advice: Let the deeper conversations happen instead of always steering around them. This one rewards the choice to go there.
